summary: Focused supplemental backend-only regression completed for Bulk Tracker Setup follow-up scope. Extended isolated tests for requested CSV/review concurrency, activation claims, worker reconcile/retry/lease behavior, and 1NCE adapter uncertainty semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: No production implementation edits were made; only isolated regression test expansion.
Requested retry/lease/conservative-resend behaviors are now explicitly covered by deterministic tests with fake provider and temporary Mongo databases.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; no live auth flow executed in this run.
seed_data_creation: Isolated tests only: per-test temporary Mongo DBs created/dropped via fixtures. No live preview provisioning records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Follow-up explicit coverage now includes: duplicate/malformed/size CSV validations, concurrent idempotent review upload with unique index, cross-tenant competing activation claims, row lease retry 409 + unconfigured retry 503, worker concurrent single-send guarantee, delivered-only counters 1..4 without resend, reconcile-all-before-fail semantics, failed->delivered pre-retry zero-resend, uncertain timeout exact SMS-list match reconciliation and zero/ambiguous no-resend, missing Location uncertain send, and adapter uncertainty mapping for 5xx/timeout vs definitive 4xx.
rca of the issue: No product bug reproduced in this focused follow-up after applying new robustness fixes. One transient failure occurred in a newly added unit assertion expecting no AsyncClient context entry when credentials are missing; corrected to assert no HTTP post/request invocation (actual requirement), then rerun passed fully.
